purpose: Modular toy-town scenery over unchanged OSM road coordinates

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game building sprite. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not geographic layout. Create ONE isolated adorable miniature cream school, mint-green tiled roof, small bell tower with gold bell, arched wooden front entrance, little front steps, flower pots at both sides. Match the supplied toy-village reference extremely closely: polished matte toy clay materials, soft bevels, pastel colors, tiny crisp architectural details, baked ambient occlusion, warm upper-left sunlight. Fixed orthographic high three-quarter overhead camera looking down about 35 degrees; front facade faces the bottom of image; visible right wall and roof. NO perspective vanishing, no blur. Complete building centered with generous transparent padding, front feet/base centered bottom. Narrow ivory foundation ONLY under building; no broad plaza, grass island or neighboring scenery. Separate sprite will be placed on real map. No people, text, label, logo, UI, ground plane, checkerboard. True alpha outside silhouette, no cast ground shadow. The school is a stylized illustration, not reconstruction of an actual building. Rich visual quality equal to reference, not low-poly wireframe.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game building sprite. Reference is STYLE ONLY. Match supplied toy village precisely: rounded matte toy clay, soft bevels and warm upper-left light, beautifully crafted smooth miniature. No ground plane, large platform, people, lettering, UI, logo, checkerboard, cast ground shadow, perspective distortion or blur. This is a stylized place marker building for a real-map 2D game.

Row2 col1: pale mint two-storey village shop with cream-and-pink striped awning, flower boxes, no lettering. Row2 col2: ivory cottage with turquoise roof, round corner, yellow door and planter. Consistent orthographic high 3/4 camera looking down35degrees, front faces bottom, right facade visible, soft upper-left lighting, baked ambient occlusion. Every building fully isolated on true transparent background, NO shared ground, NO grass patches, NO labels, NO people, NO text or UI, NO cast ground shadows, NO broad pedestals. Narrow foundations only. Generous margins around all roofs and bases. Exact2x2 atlas, not a village scene.
